indicators: Injection of mislabeled emails where spam is labeled as ham
Unusual spike in 'ham' labels for emails containing suspicious URLs
Network logs showing POST requests to training data ingestion endpoint from unknown IPs
Significant decrease in spam recall metric after retraining
Audit logs showing user submissions of suspicious dataset entries
examples.detection_method: Monitor training data label distributions for anomalies; implement input validation and sanitization of training data; track model performance metrics continuously and alert on significant drops; correlate ingestion logs with source IPs and submission patterns for suspicious activities.
